resources.string: Your photos never leave your phone. No account, no uploads.

Gallery Cleanup will flag photos, videos, and audio you may want to remove. You decide what happens to each one: leave it, move it to a locked folder, or send it to the system trash. This version only counts what you allow it to see. Nothing is deleted.
Count what is on this phone

Gallery Cleanup needs permission to read photos and videos. You can allow the whole library, only the items you pick, or none. Audio stays off until you turn it on from the home screen. Nothing is uploaded.
Photo and video access is blocked. Gallery Cleanup cannot count anything until you allow it in Settings. Nothing is uploaded either way.
Nothing is removed yet. When review is ready, you choose for each item.
Gallery Cleanup could not read the library on this phone.
Only the photos and videos you selected are visible. These counts leave out the rest of the library.
Allow all opens Settings. Set Photos and videos to Allow all.
Music and other audio are counted on this phone only, and only after you turn this on.
Audio access is blocked. You can allow it in Settings. Gallery Cleanup still will not upload anything.
On Android 11 and 12, audio uses the same storage permission as photos. Allow photos and videos first, then turn audio scanning on.
A scan reads what you have allowed, one batch at a time. Nothing is deleted or uploaded.
Scanning the library on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.
Scan cancelled. Start again to continue from the last saved batch.
Media access was removed — grant access to continue scanning
The scan stopped before it finished. Start again to continue from the last saved batch.
Allow photos or videos before scanning.
